Customer Support
FAQs

Answers to your questions

Can't find what you need? Call or text us and a real person will help.

(587) 609-8200

What services do you offer?

We offer four types of cleans: standard one-time cleans, recurring cleans, deep cleans and move-out/in cleans.

Do I have to be home when you clean?

It's up to you. You can be home if you like. If you would rather not be, just give us a reliable way to get in and we will take care of the rest.

What cleaning products do you use?

We use a variety of products depending on your needs and your home. If you have a specific request, tell one of our service agents or add a comment to your online booking.

How do I pay?

At this time we accept credit card payments for all bookings.

How can I book service?

All services are booked online through our booking page.
